courses.title: Python for AI
courses.description: Hands-on foundation in Python tailored for Artificial Intelligence, covering NumPy, Pandas, OOP, and data wrangling for AI pipelines.

courses.title: Machine Learning Basics
courses.description: Applied introduction to machine learning concepts: regression, classification, clustering, evaluation metrics, and model deployment.

courses.title: Generative AI with Python
courses.description: Learn to develop intelligent applications using Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, and API integrations.

courses.title: Data Science with Python
courses.description: Combines Python programming and exploratory data analysis, visual storytelling with Seaborn, and statistical inference.

courses.title: Deep Learning Basics
courses.description: Natural progression after ML: explore artificial neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs for computer vision, and modern optimizers.

courses.title: Computer Vision Fundamentals
courses.description: Techniques for computer vision, OpenCV video streams, object detection (YOLO), and automated visual recognition systems.

courses.title: Python Programming Masterclass
courses.description: Comprehensive grounding in Python syntax, object-oriented design, modules, unit testing, and scalable programming patterns.

courses.title: Data Analytics using Python
courses.description: Learn to extract actionable business insights from raw data pipelines using Python, SQL, and interactive dashboards.

courses.title: Network Security & Defense
courses.description: Principles of computer networks, packets, OSI layers, firewall configurations, intrusion detection systems, and defensive hardening.

courses.title: Ethical Hacking & Penetration Testing
courses.description: Learn offensive security tools and methodologies: reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, exploit frameworks, and responsible disclosure.

courses.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
courses.description: Fundamental security triad (CIA), basic cryptographic ciphers, public key infrastructure, compliance frameworks, and cyber hygiene.

courses.title: Full-Stack Web Development
courses.description: Build responsive websites and web applications from scratch with modern frontend (React) and backend API architecture.

courses.title: Cloud Computing with AWS & Docker
courses.description: Deploy, scale, and manage containerized applications in the cloud utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS EC2/S3 services.

courses.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
courses.description: Deep dive into computational linguistics, word embeddings, tokenization, Hugging Face Transformers, and text generation.
